name: Imouto wa Namaiki Kasshoku Maid-san.
original_name: 妹はナマイキ褐色メイドさん。
source:
"She’s supposed to be a healing maid, but behind the scenes, she’s got quite the attitude!"

A single flower blooming in a struggling (?) café.
A maid with a sunny smile, a warm demeanor, and a tan line that catches the eye.
But her true nature… is that of a cheeky, bratty girl.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ01001512.html/]dlsite[/url]]
